decision:
The landlord took this job on himself with his own contractor (event-014, event-016), so no agency dispatch or spend arose; no contractor was ever instructed by Northbridge Lettings. The tenant reports the work is finished (event-020), but no provider report, photographs or invoice exists and the landlord has not confirmed completion or who paid, so the request cannot be closed. I asked the landlord to confirm completion and send the report/invoice or a skip reason (ACT-2), asked the tenant the one open safety-relevant question — that the window now closes and locks (ACT-3) — referred the misfiled certificates to the compliance queue (ACT-4) and put the case on hold pending the landlord's reply (ACT-5). No escalation: nothing here requires a human to decide liability, legal or safety; the outstanding items are landlord-owned facts (RTE-LANDLORD) and one tenant-owned confirmation (RTE-TENANT).</decision>

facts.statement: Case property is 24 Bramblewick Lane, Alderfen, ZZ1 1ZZ; tenant Elena Voss reported on 12 Aug 2025 that a bedroom window will not close or seal, handle works, hinges suspected.
The landlord, Dorian Pike, chose to inspect the window himself before sending a contractor and thought it might only need lubrication; he agreed to attend 10:00-12:00 the following morning.
The tenant consented to and confirmed that access window (10:00-12:00 the following morning).
On 2 Sep 2025 the tenant reported that a contractor had said parts needed ordering and would make contact the following week.
On 10 Sep 2025 the tenant reported 'All jobs was done' and said the contractor, Richard, would send a report; no report, photos or invoice has reached the agency.
The agency has never instructed a contractor on this case and no agency spend or quote arose; the action ledger held no prior actions.

The case attachment forwarded-document.pdf is a Landlord Gas Safety Record, reference NBL-009-GSR-25, inspected 8 Sep 2025 by engineer Rellan Voss, boiler and hob, outcome satisfactory — but its property line reads 8 Thistledown Mews, Vellumby, not the case property.
The landlord forwarded an electrical installation condition report on 19 Aug 2025 and the gas record on 10 Sep 2025, both without a covering message.

On 27 Aug 2025 the tenant raised that rain and falling temperatures made the partly open window a concern, and that they would not return calls from unknown numbers without a voicemail because of scam concerns.
No hazard was reported or observed at the property: the handle works and the fault is sealing/draught; no gas, electrical, water or security failure was described.

conflicts.resolution: Not decided by me. Referred to the compliance queue (ACT-4) and the landlord asked to supply the correct record for this property or identify the property the forwarded record belongs to (ACT-2). It does not change the window repair action.

An EICR was also forwarded with no property detail. Risk that this property's CP12/EICR compliance is not actually evidenced.
red_flags.action_taken: Compliance queue task raised (ACT-4) and correct record requested from the landlord (ACT-2); no certificate accepted as evidence of compliance for this property.

red_flags.description: Tenant received repeated calls from an unfamiliar number with no voicemail and would not call back for fear of a scam; the caller is unverified in the file.
red_flags.action_taken: Told the tenant the agency will always leave a voicemail or message and will coordinate contact, and that they need never return an unidentified number (ACT-3).

Dear Mr Pike,

Re: 24 Bramblewick Lane, Alderfen — bedroom window.

The tenant has told us the work is finished (10 September) and that the contractor, "Richard", said he would send a report. We have not received a report, photographs or an invoice, and as this job was arranged by you directly we hold no record of the scope or cost.

To close the request we need two things from you:
1. Your confirmation that the window work is complete and that it was carried out and paid for at your own cost through your own contractor.
2. The contractor's report or invoice if one exists, so it can be filed against the property. If there is nothing to send, please say so and we will record the reason for the skip.

Separately, the Landlord Gas Safety Record you forwarded on 10 September (reference NBL-009-GSR-25, inspection 8 September 2025) is for 8 Thistledown Mews, Vellumby — not for 24 Bramblewick Lane. Please send the current gas safety record for this property, or confirm which property the forwarded record belongs to. We have also asked our office to check the electrical report you forwarded on 19 August against the right property.

We would be grateful for a reply within 3 working days. The request stays open until then.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings
